dataset.name: real WANDS catalog + queries + judgments (structural_routed subset)

engine_config.baseline: fresh Apache Solr 9.10.1, restricted via {!terms f=id} POST to the identical candidate set

repetitions: 6 independent full runs (latency); NDCG/recall figures deterministic and identical across all runs

headline_result.H1_ranking_quality: FALSIFIED -- native NDCG@10=0.1521 vs Solr-restricted 0.1537, -1.05% relative (noise-level)
headline_result.H3_execution_speed_controlled: FALSIFIED -- latency ratio 0.71x-1.14x across 6 warmed runs, well under the >=2x bar
headline_result.localized_root_cause: compile_lexicon resolution-priority gap: queries frequently resolve to a coincidental attribute-level match (e.g. color=coffee in 'coffee table') instead of a real ProductType/Category entity, because the entity vocabulary (e.g. 'Coffee & Cocktail Tables') rarely matches literal shopper phrasing verbatim
